identity.basis: alexbank.ru (metadata URL) 302-redirects to abank.ru, the bank's own domain; favicon.svg is the site's own favicon mark (lowercase 'a' plus arc) matching the bank's branding; ЦБ РФ registry entry for ОГРН 1027800000194, рег. №53, confirms Банк «АЛЕКСАНДРОВСКИЙ» as an operating Saint Petersburg bank distinct from the unrelated revoked Moscow АПИБ «Александровский» (license revoked 1998-10-30).

uncertainties: favicon.svg is a compact standalone variant; the full official lockup (abank.ru/css/img/logo.ru.svg, 232x26) pairs the same emblem with wordmark text, which the catalog excludes — the standalone variant is proposed instead of the lockup.
